Someone made me feel pretty today.

A lady at work helped me learn to do my hair. I have never had my hair done ever and had no idea how to do it. I tried for a week to do it correctly but kept failing and looking dumb. So this morning she came in an hour early and showed me what to do. She is very busy, but took the time to do it, and she made me feel pretty for the first time in a while.

And I know I'm not the definition of pretty for everyone, but personally, I felt good and am grateful. To her it was a "small deal" because she is used to doing it, but it meant a lot to me. So I guess the point is, a little effort on someone's part can mean a lot to someone else.

I was worried you said "pretty" but reading and looking let me understand. Everyone likes to feel well-groomed. Even cats -- especially cats. It's an important indicator of well-being, so I'm glad you're on top of this one!
Ha ha, yes, I'm on top of it :) I guess well groomed would've been a better way to put it, but pretty was the first word that came to mind.

I always think it's funny the lengths you ladies go to... have curly hair? Spend countless hours trying to straighten it.... Have straight hair? Spend countless hours trying to curl it....

FWIW, my wife has curly. It took a decade, but I finally got her to see the lunacy of spending so much time trying to change something that's a fundamental part of "Her". She also let go of the need to color it at the same time and let the grey start showing (she was ~33 when this started).... her hair has never looked better in terms of health.

I'm glad you feel pretty, just pointing out something I find funny.
